title: HelioFITS Peek
description: HelioFITS Peek teaches macOS Finder and Quick Look to read solar FITS files. A thumbnail extension renders each file in the colormap its header calls for, a Quick Look extension gives an interactive preview with pixel values, helioprojective coordinates, region statistics and multi-HDU blink comparison, and a Spotlight importer makes header fields searchable. A viewer app shows the full header, exports PNG and copies a sunpy snippet that loads the HDU on screen. It vendors CFITSIO (NASA HEASARC) under its own licence.
